***[[2025 Goma offensive]]
****[[Rwanda]]n-backed [[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels say they will march on the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] capital city [[Kinshasa]] and install a new government as [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese president]] [[Félix Tshisekedi]] calls for a [[mobilization]] of young males to reclaim lost territory. Congolese [[Minister of Defence (Democratic Republic of the Congo)|defence minister]] [[Guy Kabombo Muadiamvita]] says there will be no [[peace process|peace talks]] with the rebels. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-m23-goma-rwanda-tshisekedi-south-africa-ca81f34f52ea31b85dd845b049a0bb96 (AP)]
****After establishing a new  administration in [[Goma]], [[Congo River Alliance]] leader [[Corneille Nangaa]] confirms his forces now plan on overthrowing president Félix Tshisekedi. He also says services in the city will return to normal soon as the [[United Nations]] warns of a [[humanitarian crisis]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckgn1k9nleno (BBC News)]
***M23 forces advance into [[South Kivu]], capturing several towns and villages, including [[Kalungu, Democratic Republic of the Congo|Kalungu]] in [[Kalehe Territory]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/armed-rebels-seize-two-more-towns-after-huge-city-falls/ar-AA1y97nF (MSN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Following weeks of unsuccessful negotiations, the [[Centre Party (Norway)|Centre Party]] withdraws from the [[Støre Cabinet|Norwegian government]] over disagreements over the implementation of three directives in the [[Energy policy of the European Union|European Union's fourth energy package]], with the [[Labour_Party_(Norway)|Labour Party]] continuing as a [[Minority government|single party minority government]]. [https://www.nrk.no/norge/avviser-at-han-er-svekket-som-statsminister_-_-her-star-jeg_-jeg-er-ikke-vekk_-1.17239250 (NRK)]
*Thousands of people gather in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]], to protest against [[Chancellor of Germany|Chancellor]]-candidate [[Friedrich Merz]] and the [[Christian Democratic Union of Germany|Christian Democratic Union]] and [[Christian Social Union in Bavaria|Christian Social Union]] parties after they collaborated with the [[Alternative for Germany]] (AfD) party on a [[non-binding resolution|non-binding motion]] to restrict [[immigration to Germany|immigration]]. Members of the [[Bundestag]] debate on [[motion (legal)|motion]]s to ban the AfD, alleging that its beliefs and legal practices are [[Constitution of Germany|unconstitutional]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-mass-protests-after-far-right-afd-helps-cdu-csu/a-71464257 (DW)] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/german-parliament-debates-potential-ban-on-far-right-afd/3467314 (Anadolu Ajansi)]
*The [[Nicaragua]]n [[National Assembly (Nicaragua)|National Assembly]] votes unanimously to pass several [[Constitution of Nicaragua|constitutional]] reforms that grants the [[Government of Nicaragua|government]] influence over the [[Mass media in Nicaragua|media]], extend the presidential [[term limit|term]] to 6 years, and makes [[President of Nicaragua|President]] [[Daniel Ortega]]'s [[First Lady of Nicaragua|wife]] [[Rosario Murillo]] co-President. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/30/nicaragua-approves-constitutional-reforms-giving-president-expansive-powers (Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Apollo asteroid|Apollo-type asteroid]] [[2024 YR4]] triggers [[Asteroid impact avoidance|global planetary defence procedures]] for the first time and rises to the top of the [[Palermo Technical Impact Hazard Scale]] after recent observations confirmed it has a 1-in-77 (1.3%) chance of impacting [[Earth]] on 22 December 2032. Follow up observations in 2028 will provide a more refined estimation of the likelihood of impact in 2032. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2025/jan/30/asteroid-spotted-chance-colliding-with-earth-2032 (''The Guardian'')]
